data.content_ref: inline:The RESIDUE label (SRC_012) contradicts the skeptical semantics: naming a 'standing reason' for suspension makes the suspension actionable, and actionable suspension is a de facto promotion mechanism — operators will re-examine nodes whose RESIDUE names a fixable cause, which is exactly the re-argumentation the skeptical fixpoint was designed to prevent. Refuted if: there exists a graph where RESIDUE labels are not a pure function of the grounded labels and edges — e.g., two isomorphic graphs with the same grounded extension yield different RESIDUE sets.
